--- /dev/null
+++ b/core/config.py
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+import parse
+
+_cache = {}
+
+
+async def load_config(session):
+    """Resilience contract: on origin failure serve the last-good
+    cached config. An empty cache raises — a fresh origin error must
+    not be silently masked when there is nothing valid to serve."""
+    try:
+        raw = await session.get(CONFIG_URL)
+        cfg = parse.parse(raw)
+        _cache["last_good"] = cfg
+        return cfg
+    except OriginError:
+        return _cache["last_good"]

note: Isolated defect: ParseError (a live origin bug) is masked as stale-good, and the empty fallback {} defers the failure to a distant KeyError.
